plan.title: Reverse Auction Auto-Title for Three Products

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen without using the events list as the subject is the create-screen auto-title behavior.
Configure the event as a reverse/buy auction while preserving the empty automatic title.
Select the offered reverse auction pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the second product from a different family.
Add the third specified product from a different family.
Render the pricing sheet so each added line and its delivery-location field are available.

args.goal: Set the Delivery location on the three product rows to three different plant options, one distinct plant per row, without entering a title, and leave the automatic title visible.

steps.note: Choose three distinct plant locations using the visible sheet controls; the catalog has no fixed values for the plants in the test data.
